description: The final short season returns Hercules to a series of personal and mythic conflicts before bringing his long struggle with the gods and his family history full circle.

s06e01.description: Hercules meets a Serena lookalike who convinces him to help her return one of his enemies to Hades.

s06e02.description: Deimos exploits a tribe of Amazons when Aphrodite accidentally puts them under a spell.

s06e03.description: Hercules and Oedipus battle the ruthless Creon to help Antigone assume her rightful position as Queen of Thebes.

s06e04.description: Hercules and Iolaus are asked by their old friend Vlad to fight some unusually blood-thirsty foes.

s06e05.description: Hercules must save Autolycus from taking the rap for a bank robbery his ex-wife committed.

s06e06.description: Hercules and Iolaus also travel to Egypt on a diplomatic mission only to become embroiled in a royal family feud that threatens the life of Queen Nefertiti.

s06e07.description: A witch in training frames Hercules as an evil warlock and casts a love spell on Iolaus.

s06e08.description: The fate of the world rests with Hercules when Zeus releases Hera from the Abyss of Tartarus and inadvertently lets loose the Titans.
